_comment: Which spoken phrase each visual lands on. `step` is a cue id the page understands (see deck/index.html);
`on` is a word or short phrase from that section of script.md: first occurrence, case-insensitive,
punctuation ignored. `$start` = section start, `$end` = end of speech; `offset` shifts in seconds;
`occurrence` picks a later match. `cuecut beats` reports any phrase it cannot find.
